The Coruscant-Dantooine hyperlane was an ancient '''hyperlane''' that ran from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the galactic capital, to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], from the period of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] until the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="Atlas " />

Beginning at the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]], the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] traversed through the [[Panto system]], the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]' [[Palanhi system/Legends|Palanhi system]], passing through the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] into the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Vicondor system/Legends|Vicondor]] and [[Iridonia system/Legends|Iridonia system]], and then into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Ord Cantrell system/Legends|Ord Cantrell]], [[Dartibek system|Dartibek]], [[Ord Biniir system/Legends|Ord Biniir]], [[Ord Trasi system/Legends|Ord Trasi]], and [[Neka system/Legends|Neka systems]], before terminating in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]].<ref name="Atlas " />
